theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 - 5 * x + 6 = 0) : x = 2 ∨ x = 3 := by
  have h_factored : (x - 2) * (x - 3) = 0 := by rw [h]; ring
  have h_zero_product : (x - 2 = 0 ∨ x - 3 = 0) := by exact eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h_factored
  cases h_zero_product
  case left => exact eq.symm (add_right_inj (sub_eq_zero_iff_eq.1 this))
  case right => exact eq.symm (add_right_inj (sub_eq_zero_iff_eq.1 this))
